lead: Ruma Guha Thakurta was an Indian actor, born on 3 November 1934 in Kolkata.
She died on 3 June 2019 in Kolkata at the age of 84.
She has 35 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the BFJA Awards for Best Actress.
